adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code attempts `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`, but optional chaining means the push is skipped when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, silently discarding the `teamDestinationCalendars` collected from team members. This makes the intended collective-member destination-calendar behavior no-op in that edge case.
